interactions.name: pi-pi stacking (parallel-displaced)
interactions.explanation: Aromatic rings stack face-to-face but slightly offset (~20 deg off the ring normal), not eclipsed. distance_a is the perpendicular separation component and lateral_offset_a the lateral component consumed directly by stacking.place_pickup; together they encode a centroid-centroid distance of sqrt(3.383^2 + 1.231^2) = 3.60 A at atan2(1.231, 3.383) = 20.0 deg off-normal. Basis: measured parallel-displaced stacks 3.555/3.570/3.580 A (COD 4003564, 2100607, 2100608) all round to 3.6 A; Janiak 2000 abstract: usual stacking is parallel-displaced, ring-normal angle ~20 deg, centroid-centroid up to 3.8 A. Idealized pairwise geometry - neat Set A crystals are herringbone (see DATA_SOURCES.md).
